title: Local package routes and expiring upstream leases
expected: Native npm/pip use local endpoints; the agent obtains a scoped upstream lease.
Neither native environment nor package config contains the upstream token; redirects cannot exfiltrate it.

cases.name: expired-token
cases.change: Expire the upstream lease between requests.
cases.expect: Refresh with approved scope or fail; no static privileged fallback.

cases.name: redirect
cases.change: Return an upstream redirect to an unapproved host.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
